maria_g: Quick heads-up — Logix is going live with their RTC transcription pipeline next week and flagged a potential Day-1 surge. They plan to onboard 3 product teams simultaneously and expect roughly 4-6x realtime transcript volume compared to their pilot.
aj_s: Remind me — is this the account that asked about dedicated capacity last quarter?
maria_g: Yep. They previously explored dedicated pools for embeddings; this is a separate ask for realtime streams and SLA clarity. They want an explicit Day-1 burst playbook.
ops-bot: Usage alert: Logix-prod consumed 58% of committed quota in the past 24h. Avg RPS: 380, peak 1m RPS: 1780. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/customers/logix/usage (ops metrics).
tomas_se: Technical ask — we need representative traffic samples to validate prefix/KV cache behavior for long-lived rooms. Metrics needed: median sequence length, avg per-turn tokens, avg inter-arrival per speaker.
maria_g: I have staging dumps; will DM a sample. Quick numbers from staging: median seq ~115 tokens, avg turn ~580 tokens, ~8-12s bursts per room during active sessions.
priya_onboard: If they need Day-1 burst we should run a small canary + live enablement. I can host an enablement session tomorrow 10:00 PT to walk Logix SREs through the runbook. Who can own the canary? :calendar_with_day:
tomas_se: I can run the canary. Plan: create a canary route that pins to a quantized small variant, enable prefix cache and short TTL, and monitor latency/kv-hit. If stable, promote to a dedicated pool. Canary checklist below.
tomas_se: Canary route config (proposed):
```
route: logix-rtc-canary-1742509876
model_variant: open_llm_q4_8b
caching:
  prefix_kv: true
  ttl_s: 300
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 1
  max_replicas: 6
```
aj_s: From commercial side this is a likely upsell. If we can document burst guarantees + a rollback/fallback plan they indicated willingness to sign committed capacity and add an amendment. cc @kevin_cs for renewal planning.
kevin_cs: Renewal window in ~9 months. If this expands org-wide we should convert to an annual reserved commitment. Key question: what's risk to shared pools — could this disrupt other tenants?
ops-bot: Routing impact estimate: a sustained peak of 2k RPS for ~1.5hrs projects a ~25% utilization bump on us-east1 inference pool. Fallback options: route to eu-west or enable small-model fallback (~+80-120ms p90 latency penalty, slight quality delta).
tomas_se: Need confirmation from Logix whether they accept a small-model fallback during overloads and what latency threshold is acceptable for transcript completion.
maria_g: I'll confirm with Sanjay (product lead) by EOD. For scheduling: propose canary tomorrow 11:00 PT. Owners: Tomas (canary), Priya (enablement), Maria (CS lead). Ops on-call to be available for rollback/temporary quota bump. Aj will start drafting the amendment.
aj_s: :thumbsup: I'll draft the amendment and flag legal for expedited review.
kevin_cs: Follow-ups assigned: Maria (customer comms), Tomas (SE, canary), Priya (enablement runbook), ops-oncall (quota bump + rollback). I'll set a 30m post-canary sync to review metrics and go/no-go.
maria_g: Quick pre-canary checklist I added here: - pre-canary traffic sample (maria) - create canary route + config (tomas) - runbook + enablement session (priya) - ops temporary quota bump + monitoring (ops) - commercial amendment draft (aj) I'll drop the staging logs DM and the canary route link when ready.
